steps.title: Find your footing
steps.instruction: Move left and right to follow the road through your home town.

steps.title: Take the high road
steps.instruction: Jump onto the ledge. You can steer while you are in the air.

steps.title: Claim fallen loot
steps.instruction: Approach the glowing bundle and collect it into your Item Pouch.

steps.title: Mend your wounds
steps.instruction: Open your Item Pouch, select the Redleaf Potion, and consume it.

steps.title: Suit up
steps.instruction: Move armor from your Item Pouch into its matching Equipment Slot.

steps.title: Ready your weapon
steps.instruction: Equip a one-handed weapon in Main Hand. It leaves Off Hand free for a Shield.

steps.title: Strike and guard
steps.instruction: Use your Basic Attack, then hold Guard to soften a frontal hit.

steps.title: Use a Combat Skill
steps.instruction: Trigger a hotbar skill and watch its resource cost and cooldown before using it again.

steps.title: Grow your Disciplines
steps.instruction: Open Disciplines & Levels to inspect Martial, Mystic, and World progress.

steps.title: Shape your Talents
steps.instruction: Open the Talent Tree and spend a Talent Point on an available node connected to the root.
